Name: Ziphron
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include Huwwarin, Zifran, and Al Zaafaraniyah
Description: Ziphron was a town on the northern boundary of the land, named in the boundary list of Numbers 34, after which the border went out to Hazar-enan.
BiblicalSignificance: Ziphron is a boundary name: a northern marker in the list that drew the promised land's edge.
